entities.summary: Matthew Lance Pike is an American musician best known as the guitarist of stoner/doom metal band Sleep and the vocalist and guitarist of High on Fire. With High on Fire, Pike won the 2019 Grammy Award for Best Metal Performance for the song "Electric Messiah".
